title: Optimized DNA Extraction from Blood of Various Turtle Species Using QIAamp Blood Mini Kit
author: Judy Bassaleh
materials: The extracted DNA met or exceeded the quality and quantity thresholds required for common downstream applications. For PCR-based techniques (including conventional PCR and qPCR), all samples provided ample concentration (>30 ng/µL) and acceptable purity ratios. For Sanger sequencing, which typically requires 20–50 ng/µL of clean DNA, all six samples were suitable. Furthermore, several samples, particularly those with concentrations ≥50 ng/µL and high A260/230 values, would also meet input requirements for next-generation sequencing (NGS) workflows, including amplicon sequencing and targeted capture protocols.

steps.title: Dilute Blood Sample
steps.instruction: Mix 20 µL turtle blood with 180 µL PBS in a sterile 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube to prevent clotting.

steps.title: Lysis and Digestion
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for lysis by adding Proteinase K and Buffer AL, then incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL Proteinase K to the diluted sample.
Add 200 µL Buffer AL and vortex to mix.

steps.title: Prepare for Binding
steps.instruction: Add ethanol to the mixture and vortex to mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL ethanol (70%) and vortex to mix.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Column
steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to a QIAamp spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at 6000 × g (8000 rpm) for 1 minute. Discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Wash Column with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Wash the column using Buffer AW1 and centrifuge at 6000 × g (8000 rpm) for 1 minute. Discard the flow-through.

steps.title: Wash Column with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Wash the column using Buffer AW2 and centrifuge at 16,850 × g (13,400 rpm) for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Remove Residual Ethanol
steps.instruction: Perform an optional additional spin at full speed for 1 minute to remove residual ethanol.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the genomic DNA into a clean tube.

substeps.instruction: Place the column in a clean 1.5 mL tube.
Incubate for 1 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 6000 × g (8000 rpm) for 1 min to elute DNA.
